ابتدعا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَعَا (ibtadaʕā) /ib.ta.da.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اُبْتُدِعَا (ubtudiʕā) /ub.tu.di.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اِبْتَدِعَا (ibtadiʕā) /ib.ta.di.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
